literal.prompt: В каком году состоялся первый Парад Победы в Москве?

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library dates the first Moscow Victory Parade to 24 June 1945 (L55-L57), supporting the asked event and correct year. USHMM dates Germany’s invasion of the USSR to 22 June 1941 (L100); the retained Presidential Library biography dates the Battle of Kursk to summer 1943 (L53). 1947 is two calendar years after the documented 1945 parade.
finalGroupBindings.locator: Presidential Library L55-L57; USHMM L100; Zhukov biography L53.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Первый Парад Победы прошёл в Москве 24 июня 1945 года. Его принимал маршал Георгий Жуков.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library states that the parade took place on 24 June 1945 and identifies Marshal Georgy Zhukov as the parade commander (L55-L57).

finalGroupBindings.literal: Первый Парад Победы прошёл на Красной площади 24 июня 1945 года.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The source gives the exact parade date, 24 June 1945, and places it in Moscow (L55-L57), adding the exact day and venue to the year-only question.

finalGroupBindings.literal: В 1941 году началась Великая Отечественная война.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The page identifies the Great Patriotic War as 1941–1945 and USHMM records Germany’s attack on the Soviet Union on June 22, 1941 (L100), supporting the start-year statement.
finalGroupBindings.locator: USHMM L100; Presidential Library page heading and L40-L42.

finalGroupBindings.literal: 1947 год наступил через два года после окончания Великой Отечественной войны.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library page identifies May 9, 1945 as Victory Day in the Great Patriotic War (L40-L42); 1947 is two years after 1945 by calendar arithmetic.
finalGroupBindings.locator: Presidential Library L40-L42; calendar interval 1945 to 1947.

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library biography places the Battle of Kursk in summer 1943 (L53), directly supporting this distractor’s note.

authorAssessment.fullPrompt: В каком году состоялся первый Парад Победы в Москве?
authorAssessment.note: Первый Парад Победы прошёл на Красной площади 24 июня 1945 года.
authorAssessment.grammar: «В каком году» естественно сочетается с числовым ответом «1945»; формулировка не требует падежного окончания у года.
authorAssessment.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: 1945 uniquely answers the year of the first Moscow Victory Parade; the source dates it to 24 June 1945. The note is true and useful because it adds the exact date and venue beyond the year-only prompt.

The page title dates the war to 1941–1945 and USHMM identifies the German attack on the USSR on June 22, 1941. The note is true and useful for this option.
